rules.name: Counter Charge vs Foot
rules.description:
When an enemy successfully dices to attack this unit, but before it moves, this unit may test for a counter charge.
This is a Attack at 7+.
If it succeeds, the two units meet at a proportiaonate movement between starting positions and both count as attacking. If it fails, the enemy's charge stands in place. This rule does not apply against mounted units. This may not be used if the unit is Battered.

rules.name: Missiles
rules.description: The Unit is armed with Ranged Weapons.

rules.name: Level Headed
rules.description:
This unit is better controlled than most.
May not use Wild Charge.

rules.name: Mounted Missiles
rules.description: Unit has Mounted Missiles.Wild Charge and Counter Charge may not be used.

rules.name: Flame/Spore Attack
rules.description: Unit has ranged attack. Wild Charge is removed.

rules.name: Ponderous
rules.description: This unit is better controlled than most - Removes Wild Charge.

rules.name: Weighty Projectiles
rules.description: This unit has weapons with less range than usual.

rules.name: Mounted Missiles
rules.description: This unit is armed with missile weapons.

rules.name: Chariots
rules.description: Unit is Reduced Model Unit. Unit may not enter Rogh Terrain or cross walls/ditches or similar.Armour increased to 4.

rules.name: Flame/Spore Attack
rules.description: Unit has ranged attack. Wild Charge is removed.

rules.name: Short Range Missiles
rules.description: This Unit is armed with Short Range Weapons, such as slings or javelins.

rules.name: Mixed Weapons
rules.description: This unit carries a mix of spears and missiles.

rules.name: Short Range Missiles
rules.description: This unit is armed with Javelins and other shorter ranged weapons than the usual bows/pistols.

rules.name: Hard To Target
rules.description: Scouts count as Armour2 versus Shooting and may only be targetted when within 12" of Enemy Unit.

sharedRules.name: Counter-Charge
sharedRules.description: When an enemy successfully dices to Attack this Unit, but before it moves, this unit may test for a Counter-Charge. Test for an Attack at 7+, and if it succeeds, the two units meet a proportionate movement distance between their starting distance and both count as Attacking. If it fails, the enemy's charge stands. Counter-CHarge may not be used if the Unit is Battered.

sharedRules.name: Evade
sharedRules.description: When a unit successfully dices to Attack this unit, but befor eit moves, this unit may test to Evade at 7+. If it succeeds, it immediately carries out a Skirmish action targeting the Attacking unit only, may not move closer to the Attacking unit, and must avoid other units by 3" as usual. Casualties at the end of this Skirmish attack cause a Courage test only at the end of the Attack. The charging unit then moves its full charge distance following the evading unit; if it makes contact with the Evading unit, it then Attacks, reducing the evading units Armour to 1. If the Evade test fails, the unit reduces it's Armour to 1 during the Attack. Evade cannot be used if the unit is Battered.

sharedRules.name: Fleet Footed
sharedRules.description: This unit does not halve its movement in rogh terrain.

sharedRules.name: Ranger
sharedRules.description: This Unit uses its normal Attack/Defence/Armour profile when fighting in rough terrain.

sharedRules.name: Skirmish
sharedRules.description: As an ordered activation, successful on a 7+, the unit may choose to make a half move and Shoot either before or after this movement takes place. All models in the unit Shoot with -1 to their dice scores.

sharedRules.name: Wall of Spears
sharedRules.description:
If the unit has 6 or more Strength Points it may form a Wall of Spears. On a move order. fprm the unit into base to base contact. This may not be in rough terrain or cover, and may not move whilst in this formation.
Increases Armour by 1 point against Attacks, but not Shooting. If Unit becomes Battered or Retreats, the Wall of Spears formation is broken.
Wall of Spears may not be used if Unit is Offensive has Mixed Weapons.

sharedRules.name: Wild Charge
sharedRules.description: If the Unit is within Attack range of an enemy unit, you must activate and Attack. This is the only order that may be given. Wild Charge may not be used if the Unit is Battered.

rules.name: Blessed Weapons
rules.description:
At the start of the game, roll a die, on a roll of 5 or 6, the unit re-rolls all misses once for all Attacks, Melee or Missile.
You must choose which weapons, Melee or Missile are Magical at the start of the game.

rules.name: Cleric/Slayer
rules.description:
A Cleric/Slayer unit identifies their nemesis at the start of the game- 
Undead, Trolls, Ogres etc.
Their powers are only usable against units of this type.
They count as owning Enchanted Weapons against this type, without the need to roll for effectiveness at the start of the game.
They may ignore fear conferred by units of their target type.
Warbands that include Undead may not include Clerics.

rules.name: Enchanted Weapons
rules.description:
At the start of the game, roll a die, on a roll of a 6, the unit re-rolls all misses once for all Attacks, Melee or Missile.
You must choose which weapons, Melee or Missile are Magical at the start of the game.

rules.name: Exploder
rules.description:
As an ordered activation on 5+, an Exploder Unit will explode. Failed activation means the unit implodes and is removed without affecting anything else. A successful explosion affects ALL units with 6" radius of the exploding unit. This is resolved as a Shooting Attack on a 3+.
Once exploded, the unit is removed from play as destroyed.

rules.name: Fear
rules.description:
Courage tests caused as a result of Attacking (not shooting) suffer additional -1 to total.
Should two units with fear encounter, the effect is cancelled. Undead units are not affected by Fear.

rules.name: Fearful
rules.description: Fearful units takes -1 from the total of all Courage and Rally tests. If being attacked by Fear causing units, then this cumulates to -2.

rules.name: Flying/Burrowing
rules.description:
Flying units may move over/under friends and enemies alike, but may end their move no closer than 3" as normal.
Flying units ignore all terrain for movement and Attacks - unless cover provided by a defender is agreed to provide shelter from these units beforehand.

rules.name: Hatred
rules.description:
A unit must have a Hatred of a particular race - Dwarves, Trolls, Humans etc, named before the start of the game. All units with this rule in the Warband must name the same race.
Units with Hatred gain the Wild Charge ability against that enemy. If a unit already has Wild Charge, it now automatically passes the Wild Charge test.

rules.name: Invisibility
rules.description:
Invisible units do not block line of sight and may not be targetted by ranged Attacks, except spells.
Invisible units are visible during Attacks and may be Attacked.
Invisible units can achive objectives and units may not pass through them as per normal unit rules.

rules.name: Leader
rules.description:
Rolls two dice at the start of the game on the Leadership trait table.
May not join units as it IS a unit.

rules.name: Unstoppable March of the Dead
rules.description:
Leadeship Trait for Undead units.
If an Undead leader rolls 8 or higher on the Leadership table, the Warband only ever takes Courage tests from Attacking, Shooting or Rallying.

rules.name: Mystical Armour
rules.description: For each Strenghth Point lost, roll a die, on a 6, the lost point is ignored.

rules.name: No Feelings
rules.description:
This unit has a Courage value of 0+ - the unit will never be Battered, but will still rout on a negative final score. They also ignore Fear.
Any hits on this unit are rounded up - three hits remove 2 Strength Points from an Armour 2 Unit.

rules.name: Summoner
rules.description:
A number of units can be left off-table at the start of the game to be later summoned.
The Summoner can Summon a unit on 6+ activation per turn. If at half strength or less, -1 to this activation.
If a scenario requires some of your units to be left off-table at the start, the Summoner is at -1 activation for this game.

If successfuly Summoned, the unit is placed within 12" of the Summoner and no closer than 6" to enemy. If not placeable, it must be left off-table.
A Summoned unit is usally Flying/Nurrowing or Undead.
The Summoned unit may not take any action this turn.
Summoned units are not counted as casualties/victory if not summoned.

rules.name: Venomous
rules.description: Any unit with the Venomous rule counts any Attack die roll of 6 as 2 Strength Points of damage.

rules.name: Flame/Spore Attack
rules.description: Unit has ranged attack. Wild Charge is removed.
